title: Unusual modifications of protein biomarkers expressed by plasmid, prophage, and bacterial host of pathogenic Escherichia coli identified using top-down proteomic analysis.
authors: Fagerquist, Clifton K; Shi, Yanlin; Park, Jihyun
journal: Rapid communications in mass spectrometry : RCM
one_liner_zh: 该文用自上而下蛋白质组学鉴定致病大肠杆菌的蛋白生物标志物，虽用AlphaFold2做结构预测，但核心是质谱实验与蛋白修饰鉴定，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点或互作机制建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: RATIONALE: Pathogenic bacteria often carry prophage (bacterial viruses) and plasmids (small circular pieces of DNA) that may harbor toxin, antibacterial, and antibiotic resistance genes. Proteomic characterization of pathogenic bacteria should include the identification of host proteins and proteins produced by prophage and plasmid genomes. METHODS: Protein biomarkers of two strains of Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli (STEC) were identified using antibiotic induction, matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization tandem time-of-flight (MALDI-TOF-TOF) tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) with post-source decay (PSD), top-down proteomic (TDP) analysis, and plasmid sequencing. Alphafold2 was also used to compare predicted in silico structures of the identified proteins to prominent fragment ions generated using MS/MS-PSD. Strain samples were also analyzed with and without chemical reduction treatment to detect the attachment of pendant groups bound by thioester or disulfide bonds. RESULTS: Shiga toxin was detected and/or identified in both STEC strains. For the first time, we also identified the osmotically inducible protein (OsmY) whose sequence unexpectedly had two forms: a full and a truncated sequence. The truncated OsmY terminates in the middle of an alpha-helix as determined by Alphafold2. A plasmid-encoded colicin immunity protein was also identified with and without attachment of an unidentified cysteine-bound pendant group (~307 Da). Plasmid sequencing confirmed top-down analysis and the identification of a promoter upstream of the immunity gene that is activated by antibiotic induction, that is, SOS box. CONCLUSIONS: TDP analysis, coupled with other techniques (e.g., antibiotic induction, chemical reduction, plasmid sequencing, and in silico protein modeling), is a powerful tool to identify proteins (and their modifications), including prophage- and plasmid-encoded proteins, produced by pathogenic microorganisms.
abstract_zh: RATIONALE：病原菌常携带前噬菌体（细菌病毒）和质粒（小型环状DNA），这些可能含有毒素、抗菌及抗生素抗性基因。病原菌的蛋白质组学特征分析应包括宿主蛋白以及前噬菌体和质粒基因组产生的蛋白质的鉴定。METHODS：通过抗生素诱导、基质辅助激光解吸电离串联飞行时间（MALDI-TOF-TOF）串联质谱（MS/MS）结合源后衰变（PSD）、自上而下蛋白质组学（TDP）分析及质粒测序，鉴定了两株产志贺毒素大肠杆菌（STEC）的蛋白质生物标志物。还使用Alphafold2将预测的蛋白质计算机模拟结构与MS/MS-PSD产生的显著片段离子进行比较。菌株样本还进行了有无化学还原处理的对比分析，以检测通过硫酯键或二硫键结合的悬垂基团。RESULTS：在两株STEC中均检测到和/或鉴定出志贺毒素。我们首次还鉴定出渗透压诱导蛋白（OsmY），其序列意外地具有两种形式：全长和截短序列。根据Alphafold2确定，截短的OsmY终止于α-螺旋中间。还鉴定出一种质粒编码的大肠菌素免疫蛋白，其有无未鉴定的半胱氨酸结合悬垂基团（约307 Da）的附着。质粒测序证实了自上而下分析，并鉴定出免疫基因上游的一个启动子，该启动子由抗生素诱导激活，即SOS盒。CONCLUSIONS：TDP分析结合其他技术（如抗生素诱导、化学还原、质粒测序和计算机模拟蛋白质建模），是鉴定病原微生物产生的蛋白质（及其修饰）的强大工具，包括前噬菌体和质粒编码的蛋白质。
